title: Amazon API Gateway AWS Lambda authorizer for basic HTTP authentication
description: API Gateway REST API protected by a Lambda Authorizer supporting basic HTTP authentication.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The Lambda authorizer decodes the credentials provided in the Authorization header. If authorized a policy is returned giving permissions to invoke the downstream Lambda function. If the user is not found a policy is returned denying access to the downstream Lambda function.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
